q: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer:
You have to do this yourself. Admins cannot cancel it for you. PPN admin Angela Foudriat, 16 June 2026: "We cannot cancel your account. Only you can. We do not have access to your personal/banking information."

Do it in a web browser, not the app. Open Safari or Chrome (on your phone is fine), go to patriotchute.com and sign in there. The Mighty Networks app does not reliably show the billing screens.

1. Tap your profile picture in the top right corner. (On a phone you may instead see three lines in a top corner - tap those and scroll to the very bottom.)
2. Tap Personal Settings.
3. Tap Plans and Purchases. Newer screens call this Plans and Access. The site owner's own 2026 wording is: Personal Settings, then Billing. Any of the three gets you to the same place.
4. Under Active Subscriptions, tap PPN - The Patriot Party News.
5. Scroll down to the Cancel Subscription box outlined in red. Tap it.
6. IMPORTANT - a second screen appears. You must also tap Cancel My Subscription to confirm. If you stop after step 5 you are NOT cancelled. This is almost certainly why several members said "I've tried 3 times and it still comes up on my bank statement."
7. Go back into that same screen afterwards to check. If it no longer shows an active subscription or an upcoming charge, it worked.

The fee is $8.99 a month. You do not need to get a new bank card to stop it - one member cancelled specifically to avoid that, and it is not necessary.

2. Scroll down. Keep scrolling - the state groups sit a long way down the list.
3. Find your state and tap it. That is your room. It stays in that menu from then on.

If your state is not in that list, you are not in it yet:
1. From the same Menu, go to ➽ START HERE and open JOIN YOUR STATE GROUP.
2. Say which state you are in.
3. Now watch your notifications - the bell icon, top right on a computer, bottom right in the phone app. Your invite arrives there, not by email.

- The invite can take a day or two. A volunteer sends them by hand.
- Old instructions still circulating are wrong. "Resources > Get Invited To Join Your State" was the 2023 route. "Menu > ⭐️STATE GROUP INVITE⭐️" was the 2025 route and that space no longer exists under that name. Ignore both.

- The state room on this site and the state voice channel on Discord are two different things with the same name. Being in one does not put you in the other.

State Talk on Discord is separate. It opened in December 2025. The invite and instructions live in the JOIN DISCORD | State Talk space, but that space sits in a part of the menu members cannot browse to, so the only way in is the direct link an admin posted. Your Discord display name must match your PatriotChute name, spaces included, or verification fails. If you cannot create a Discord account because it wants a different email address, there is no published workaround - an admin has to answer that one.

Not in the USA? You are not stuck with nothing, whatever the onboarding implies. There are two country groups on this site, Canada and United Kingdom, in the ➽ OTHER COUNTRIES section of the Menu. q: How do I set up my microphone and hear people in Talk Time?
answer:
Two different problems get mixed up here. Find yours first.

A. "I can see the text but I cannot hear anyone."
You are almost certainly in the text channel, not the voice channel. They are separate rooms with similar names. On a phone: tap the three lines at the top left, find the list of channels, scroll down to Voice Channels, and tap the voice room (it has been called PT-VOICE). Text channels have a # in front of them. Voice channels have a little speaker. You have to tap the voice one.

B. "I am in, but nobody can hear me." 
Discord starts you in Push To Talk mode, which means your microphone stays off until you hold a key or a button. Turn it on properly:

On a computer (written by member Dave Vallese, Dec 2025):
1. Click the gear icon next to your name, bottom left - that is User Settings.
2. Scroll down and click Voice and Video.
3. Scroll down to Input Mode.
4. Make sure PUSH TO TALK is switched on.
5. Just below it is a Shortcut with an EDIT KEYBIND button.
6. Press Edit Keybind, then press the key you want to use. The space bar works well. Hold that key while you speak.
You can change the key later the same way.

On a phone (written by member CountryDen DigitalWarrior, July 2023):
1. Tap your own icon at the bottom right.
2. Scroll to APP SETTINGS and tap Voice.
3. If it says Voice Activity, change it to Push to Talk.
4. Press back twice to return to the server, scroll to Voice Channels and tap the voice room.
5. A box pops up. Join Muted means you can hear everyone but they cannot hear you - that is fine if you only want to listen. Join Voice turns your microphone on.
6. To switch your microphone on and off later, swipe up from the bottom of the phone to bring the controls back.

Three gotchas people get stuck on:
- Discord will not let you into a voice room until your phone has granted it microphone permission. If you are being bounced out, go to your phone's Settings, find Discord, and turn Microphone on. You have to do this even if you only ever want to listen.
- If you only want to listen, use Join Muted. You do not need a headset or a microphone of your own.
- Do the setup at a quiet time, not during a live show. Members have run mic checks for each other in the room - go in, say you need a mic check, and someone will help.

q: Verification keeps failing or sending me back to the start - how do I fix it?
answer:

Fix: open Discord, go to Verify, tap the thumbs-up again, and leave the phone on that screen.

Cause 2 - your name stopped matching. Discord sometimes changes your display name by itself - lower-casing it, or adding a dot or a number. You did nothing wrong. Fix: check your Discord display name against your PatriotChute name and correct it, then tap the thumbs-up again.

Cause 3 - 'You do not have permission to view the verify message'. Repeated tapping will not clear this. Leave the server, get the current invite from the JOIN DISCORD | State Talk page, rejoin, and start again.

What NOT to do: do not delete and re-download Discord (it was suggested but never confirmed to work), and do not make a brand-new Discord profile - at least one member did and was sent straight back to Verify anyway.

If you have gone round twice, stop and get a person. Message Liz Olive or Alice The Equalizer. Going round a third time will not work.

q: I've never used Zoom - how do I install it and join the meeting?

3. Zoom will ask for your name. Type your name and tap OK.
4. Tap "Join with Video" or "Join without Video" - either is fine.
5. IMPORTANT: tap "Call using Internet Audio" (or "Wifi or Cellular Data") when it asks. If you skip this you will see people but hear nothing.

If you do not have room on your phone or computer to install Zoom:
You can join without installing anything. Open the link, and on the page that appears look for the small grey words "Join from your browser" near the bottom. Tap that.

If you only have a Meeting ID and a Passcode and no link:
Go to zoom.us/join, type the Meeting ID with no spaces, tap Join, then type the Passcode exactly - it is case sensitive, so a capital letter must stay capital.

- The most common cause is an old link. Go back into your state room, tap the Events tab, and click the link there instead - a member who had this exact problem got straight in that way.
- Or the host has not started the call yet. "Waiting for the host" means you are in the right place - just wait.

If you are in but nobody can hear you:
Tap the middle of the screen so the buttons appear, then look at the microphone icon in the bottom left. A red line through it means you are muted. Tap it once to unmute.

ALICE USUALLY GRABS THEM AND DELETES THEM. DOESN'T HAPPEN VERY OFTEN. IT'S THE BAD GUYS WHO DO THIS."

Steps to take:
1. Take a screenshot of the fake posts before they disappear.
2. Work out WHERE it is happening. This matters, because it decides who can fix it. Ask yourself: was it in the live show chat on Rumble or Twitch, on the PatriotChute site itself, or on Discord (Patriot Talk)? The first thing members asked the reporter was "Were you on Rumble, PPN, Twitch?"

q: How do I change my name, email or phone number on my account?
answer:
It depends which thing you want to change. They live in three different places.

YOUR NAME (how you appear in the community)
1. Tap your profile picture.
2. Tap Edit your bio / Edit profile.
3. Change the name.
4. Tap Save.
That is the exact answer a member gave in March 2022: 'Click Edit your bio, change name, click save.' Gotcha: several members in July 2023 reported the edit screen simply refusing to change the display name ('it will not let me edit the display name'). If that happens to you it is not your mistake - report it.

YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS OR PASSWORD
1. Sign in using a WEB BROWSER, not the phone app.
2. Tap your profile picture.
3. Tap Personal Settings.
4. Tap Account.
Use a browser for anything account-level. The admin team stated in July 2025 that card details cannot be changed in the app at all - 'YOU MUST USE A WEB BROWSER AND SIGN IN. YOU CAN NOT USE THE APP' - and the same limitation trips people up on other account screens.

where: Split: the name half belongs in ➽ START HERE > Welcome & New Member Guide STEP 3 'Complete Your Profile' (space 22517246), which already covers profile editing but never mentions the display-name problem. The email/password/phone half belongs in ➽ QUESTION & SUPPORT > FAQ Zone (space 7010251) next to the billing items, since it shares the same 'use a browser, not the app' gotcha.

q: Does my project have to be overseas, or can it be here in the USA?
answer:
No - your project does not have to be overseas. It can be right where you live, and local projects are welcomed.

The only direct answer ever given in the community was from another member in 2022: "absolutely!! doing something local is recommended."

What is actually posted in the room backs that up. Nearly every project in the Humanitarian Projects room is American and local: a nursing home in central Louisiana, help for Florida families who lost homes in Ian, Milton and Helene, replacing roofs and windows in Utah, a tiny-house community for elderly people, a ministry in Alabama, a dog-shelter programme, a healing and learning campus on a 40-acre parcel near one member's town.

The only category list that has ever circulated has no geography in it at all. It reads: Education, Water and soil clean-up, Oceans/lakes/rivers/reforestation, Food, Medical, Technology, Energy, Arts, Library and School, Science, Agriculture, Special Needs and Disabled, Senior Care, Veterans, Children, Animals, Other. Overseas work is allowed too - some members have posted international projects - but it has never been a requirement.

One honest caveat: no admin or host has ever published written eligibility rules. Everything above is drawn from one member's reply and from what is visibly accepted in the room. If a real rule exists, only PPN leadership can state it.
where: Inside the same pinned 'How to submit a humanitarian project' post in Humanitarian Projects (4758493) - as a short 'Does it have to be overseas?' line. It is too small to deserve its own destination and members will never search for it separately.
action: Do not build a standalone card. Answer it in one line inside the submit-my-project flow ('Local or overseas - both are fine, and local is what most members do'), and offer the category list as a tappable expander so someone unsure what counts can see the seventeen accepted categories. Label the answer as community practice rather than official policy, and add it to the admin gap list so leadership can confirm or correct it.
